name: research-lab
description: Self-contained knowledge-work verbs as standalone compositional primitives: frame, gather, understand, seminar, synthesize, interrogate, experiment, teach. Each digests existing information or tests and ships a claim; preflight-first input contracts; verbs suggest next steps but never force a pipeline. seminar is the one multi-agent study: students question a corpus, a skeptic debates the answers, and interrogate scores what settles. No hard dependency on other plugins.
